spaces.title: Anderson Design Lab
spaces.summary: Start a project with 3D printers, laser cutters, electronics tools and flexible workbenches. Ask the lab staff how to begin.

image.alt: Students work at shared wooden benches in the Anderson Design Lab.
image.credit: © Regents of the University of Minnesota

spaces.title: Anderson Build Lab
spaces.summary: Explore woodworking, welding, 3D printing and larger fabrication projects. Classes and student groups also use this space.

image.alt: Workbenches and fabrication equipment in the Anderson Build Lab.
image.credit: © Regents of the University of Minnesota

spaces.title: Polaris Student Machine Shop
spaces.summary: See metalworking tools, milling machines, lathes and a waterjet cutter, with staff guidance on manufacturing design.

image.alt: Students observe a waterjet cutter in the Anderson student machine shop.
image.credit: © Regents of the University of Minnesota

spaces.title: Exceed Lab
spaces.summary: A collaborative engineering workspace for student teams developing extracurricular science and engineering projects. Training is required for access.

spaces.title: Bakken Medical Devices Center
spaces.summary: Discover medical device prototyping, electronics and mechanical labs. Arrange access and complete the required training before using equipment.

spaces.title: Health Sciences Library Makerspace
spaces.summary: Make with printing, sewing, electronics, laser cutting and craft equipment on HSEC's fifth floor. Equipment and materials are free to use.

spaces.title: The Toaster Makerspace
spaces.summary: Visit the makerspace inside the Toaster Innovation Hub for crafting, sewing, cutting and 3D printing, with staff support.

spaces.title: Rapson Fabrication Shops
spaces.summary: Explore the laser lab, metal shop, materials store and woodshop. Check the College of Design's current access requirements.

spaces.title: AISOS
spaces.summary: The Advanced Imaging Service for Objects and Spaces supports precise imaging of objects, samples and artifacts in two and three dimensions.

spaces.title: eStudio
spaces.room: Regis Center for Art West W206
spaces.summary: An interdisciplinary, collaborative art studio open to University of Minnesota students. Check the studio's current facilities and schedule.

spaces.title: XYZ Lab
spaces.room: Regis Center for Art East E125
spaces.summary: Try digital fabrication with laser cutters, 3D printers, vinyl cutters and a CNC router. Book an appointment for machine access.

spaces.title: McNeal Laser Lab
spaces.summary: Find the laser lab in room 334A and the Free Fabric Room in 334B. Visits are by appointment.
